styles.name: Clear-line adventure
styles.rules: Use clean even dark contours, simplified readable shapes, flat saturated colors, sparse cel shadows, and clear compositions. Keep character proportions and line weight consistent across panels. Do not imitate a named artist.

styles.name: Ink manga
styles.rules: Use black and white ink, expressive controlled line weight, sparse screentone for tonal areas, crisp silhouettes, and economical high-contrast composition. Translate color-coded identity into shape and value; do not depend on literal color. Do not imitate a named artist.

styles.name: Painted storybook
styles.rules: Use soft gouache-like painted texture, restrained warm colors, simple recognizable shapes, gentle shadows, and clear compositions. Retain stable character silhouettes and identity anchors across panels. Do not imitate a named artist.
